h1: How to Import Kurtis from India to Singapore Wholesale
lead: Run a boutique in Little India, an online store or a live-selling business in Singapore? Clothing is duty-free in Singapore. Here is how GST, documents and shipping work for kurtis from India.
seo_title: Import Kurtis from India to Singapore Wholesale (No Duty, GST Guide)
seo_description: Singapore boutiques: import Indian kurtis with no customs duty, 9% GST, UEN and courier permits, 5–10 day express shipping and MOQ 15–20 pieces from a Jaipur manufacturer.
body:
## Quick answer

Singapore charges **no customs duty on clothing**, so kurtis and suits from India pay only **9% GST** at import (confirm low-value rules with your courier). Your courier usually files the import permit using your **UEN**. Express shipping takes about **5–10 business days**.

## Duty and tax at a glance

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Customs duty on apparel | 0% |
| GST at import | 9% |
| Typical express transit from India | About 5–10 business days |

## Documents you need

- **Commercial invoice** from the supplier
- **IEC** on the Indian side – we have this
- Your **UEN** with an activated customs account (the courier files the permit)

## Labelling

There is no specific mandatory textile label, but fibre and care labels help your customers. We can stitch your own labels.

## Tips for boutiques

- Deepavali and Pongal are peak seasons – order 6–8 weeks ahead
- Fast transit makes small, frequent reorders easy
- Test 3–5 designs first, then reorder bestsellers

Ready to start? [WhatsApp us](https://wa.me/917073350886) with your styles and quantities, or fill the [wholesale enquiry form](/wholesale/#enquiry). *This guide is general information for buyers, not legal or customs advice. Duty rates depend on the exact HS code and fabric, and rules change, so always confirm with your customs broker or courier before importing. Information checked November 2026.*
